title: Delhi High Court says it will decide whether Mahua Moitra can visit pet Rottweiler Henry
description: The Delhi High Court on Wednesday said that it will decide whether Trinamool Congress (TMC) Member of Parliament (MP) Mahua Moitra can visit pet Rottweiler dog Henry, which is currently with her former boyfriend, advocate Jai Anant Dehadrai.Justice Jasmeet Singh said he will hear the matter next week. This was after Moitra and Dehdrai failed to reach an arrangement over the former visiting Henry.The Court had on July 7 asked the two parties to explore an arrangement under which Moitra can meet H
